summary_1line: Bhrigu explains that all beings and senses arise from five elements, arguing even trees possess life and perception through these elemental properties.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Bhrigu teaches Bharadwaja beneath forest trees while explaining how earth, water, fire, wind, and space form all living bodies.
A great tree with roots drinking water, leaves drooping in heat, and vines winding around it, symbolizing hidden senses within plants.
A symbolic diagram-like vision of a human body formed from earth, water, fire, wind, and space with senses radiating from each element.
